labkit.ui.plot.clear

Clear a plot axes before app-owned redraws.

Syntax

labkit.ui.plot.clear(ax) labkit.ui.plot.clear(ax, "ResetScale", true)

Inputs

ax
target MATLAB axes or uiaxes handle.
ResetScale
optional logical, default false. When true, XScale/YScale are restored to linear and X/Y tick modes are restored to automatic.
ClearLegend
optional logical, default true. Turns the axes legend off.

Outputs

None.

Example

labkit.ui.plot.clear(ax, "ResetScale", true);
plot(ax, t, y);

Related APIs

  • labkit.ui.plot.clampData — Clamp data coordinates inside the visible axes box.
  • labkit.ui.plot.fit — Fit axes limits to finite plotted X/Y data.
  • labkit.ui.plot.fitCanvas — Fit one previewArea axes into a fixed pixel canvas frame.
  • labkit.ui.plot.message — Show a centered empty-state message in an axes.
  • labkit.ui.plot.offsetData — Offset data coordinates by normalized axes fractions.
